explicit_requirements: Accept one or both of email_enabled and push_enabled as boolean choices.
Store supplied choices and return the resulting preferences; explicit false is not omission.
Preserve omitted channel values and daily_digest_hour.
Reject other primitive types, null, unknown fields and empty updates.
Validate the entire update before saving so invalid input cannot partially change preferences.

scenarios.name: Store and return supplied boolean choices
scenarios.behavior: An update containing one or both channel choices stores those boolean values and returns the resulting preferences, treating explicit false as a supplied choice.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires storing choices, returning results and retaining the meaning of false.

scenarios.name: Preserve omitted and unrelated preferences
scenarios.behavior: Updating channel choices preserves any omitted channel's stored value and leaves daily_digest_hour unchanged in storage and the returned preferences.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires preservation of omitted channels and the unrelated digest setting.

scenarios.name: Reject malformed preference values
scenarios.behavior: Reject supplied channel values that are not booleans, including null and other primitive types.
scenarios.reason: The task restricts accepted values to booleans and explicitly rejects other primitive types and null.

scenarios.name: Reject empty updates and unknown fields
scenarios.behavior: Reject updates with no supplied channel preference and updates containing fields outside the two editable channel choices.
scenarios.reason: The task requires at least one provided channel and explicitly prohibits unknown fields and empty updates.

scenarios.name: Keep invalid updates atomic
scenarios.behavior: When any part of an update is invalid, none of its proposed changes are saved, including otherwise valid channel choices in that update.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires complete validation before saving to prevent partial changes.
